record.title: Circle (Circle National Trust)
record.sub: Circle group context: USDC issuance is separate from this national trust bank. The bank does custody and trust work; it does not issue USDC.
kv: No Federal Reserve account found in the library or in the saved 2026-10-19 web check. The OCC letter requires the bank to apply for Federal Reserve Bank stock, which is a membership step and not an account.
record.text: No account is recorded in this saved research; this does not prove that no account exists.
open: Has Circle National Trust applied for Federal Reserve Bank stock or a Fed account? Not found.
When will reserve management move to the trust bank? Circle describes it as a future step.
Circle National Trust is not the USDC issuer; who issues USDC is outside this master.
